note: Values of the Mars place tools (assets-src/mars/place). oldLadder: the levels of main that the old land is read from.

dehaze.note: dehaze.py: the dark envelope of the place picture by distance from the twin and picture column; landKnee and landMost: the luminance of the land (scene) is bent over above landKnee and never passes landMost (what is brighter in the picture is taken as glow)

lead.note: lead.py: light is what the globe multiplies a lit level with near the ground at T (r g b, measured with flat.sh and light.py); the old land keeps its brightness and is moved by paletteMix to the hue of the picture's land (paletteHue, the median where the lay back leads at 1.2 deg) inside paletteCoreDeg, fading out to paletteEndDeg

force.note: force.py: pictureStep is the grid of the twin's picture the comparison runs on (picture px), blurPx the blur of the difference (picture px), share how much of it is added, directFrom to directTo the stretch (plate texels per picture px) over which the lay back itself stops being used; spreadDeg is how far outside the fan the difference fades out (degrees on the ground), spreadShare its share at the edge, spreadBlurPx the blur of the spread field (plate px); edgePx the feather of the fan edge on the plate (plate px); calmShare how far the broad colour of the far fan (seen, but through thick haze) is brought to the land around it, calmBlurDeg the blur of that comparison (degrees), calmLeast and calmMost the limits of the ratio; groundBlur: the difference is blurred on the ground with a radius of blurPx x stretch x groundBlur plate px; calmHue how far the far fan takes the hue of the land around; outside the fan the broad tone of the take (blur of toneBlur of the plate width) is brought by a gain (toneLeast to toneMost) to the tone at the nearest edge of the fan, fading over spreadDeg

bake.note: bake.py: plates from the deepest up (look: the plate of force.py, empty for the toned old land), the new lit level, the lit levels above that take the difference, the options of the stop; matchBlur and matchReach (shares of the plate width): the broad difference to the plate above is added at the rim and fades out matchReach inside it; matchLeast and matchMost bound the gain of the rim match; lookKnee and lookMost: the luminance of a plate (look values) is bent over above lookKnee and never passes lookMost
bake.ladderNote: Eight levels: 96, 42, 19 lit; 8.5, 3.8, 1.6, 0.7, 0.3 with their own light. Chosen with predict.py on the paths of E3 (agent/engine-handover 0d14d1c): dive worst 0.0082, rise worst 0.0168 of ground pixels under 1.0 texels, inside 1400 MB of the full set. Nine levels with every density doubled (96 ... 0.3) read 0.0006 and 0.0096 but need 53 MB more than the set may use.
